name: CDC-ACM UART Bridge
description: The CDC-ACM UART Bridge (the `cdc_acm_uart` platform of the [Bridge](https://esphome.io/components/bridge/) component) enables supported ESP32 microcontrollers to act as a USB-to-serial adapter, creating a bidirectional bridge between a UART interface and a USB CDC-ACM (Communications Device Class - Abstract Control Model) interface. This allows the microcontroller to appear as a virtual serial/COM port on a host computer while keeping the UART parameters in sync with the host.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the UART bus to bridge to the USB CDC-ACM interface.

config_entries.label: Dtr Pin
config_entries.description: GPIO pin that mirrors the host's DTR (Data Terminal Ready) line state. This is typically asserted when the host opens the serial port and is commonly used to drive the reset line of an attached device. The pin carries the logical line state (asserted/deasserted); for a conventional active-low interface (`DTR#`), set `inverted: true` on the pin (see [Control Signals](https://esphome.io/components/bridge/cdc_acm_uart#control-signals)).

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Rts Pin
config_entries.description: GPIO pin that mirrors the host's RTS (Request to Send) line state. Combined with `dtr_pin`, this is commonly used to drive the bootloader/reset sequence of an attached device. As with `dtr_pin`, set `inverted: true` for a conventional active-low interface (`RTS#`).

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: USB Cdc Acm ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the USB CDC-ACM interface to use for the USB side of the bridge.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component.
